description: UHF Radiating Patch -> UHF Probe Feed Via. Probe located 30 mm off patch centre along the resonant length, transitioning from Z = 3.5 mm down to the ground reference at Z = 0.
UHF Probe Feed Via -> UHF Matching Pad Site. 50 ohm microstrip on Kapton flex (er = 3.5, h = 3.5 mm).
UHF Matching Pad Site -> UHF Radio U.FL. Series position populated 0 ohm; shunt positions DNP until VNA trimming.
UHF Radio U.FL -> UHF Coax Pigtail. 50 ohm ruggedized coax to the bulkhead connector, routed along the helmet shell.
L-Band Radiating Patch -> L-Band Probe Feed Via. Probe located 16 mm off patch centre, transitioning from Z = 3.5 mm down to Z = 0.
L-Band Probe Feed Via -> L-Band Matching Pad Site. 50 ohm microstrip on Kapton flex.
L-Band Matching Pad Site -> L-Band Video U.FL. Series position populated 0 ohm; shunt positions DNP until VNA trimming.
L-Band Video U.FL -> L-Band Coax Pigtail. 50 ohm ruggedized coax to the bulkhead connector.
Underside RF Shield / Ground Plane -> UHF Probe Feed Via. Ground return at Z = 0; this plane is both the patch ground and the head-isolation shield.
Underside RF Shield / Ground Plane -> L-Band Probe Feed Via. Ground return at Z = 0.
Underside RF Shield / Ground Plane -> UHF Matching Pad Site shunt returns.
Underside RF Shield / Ground Plane -> L-Band Matching Pad Site shunt returns.
Underside RF Shield / Ground Plane -> UHF Radio U.FL shell ground.
Underside RF Shield / Ground Plane -> L-Band Video U.FL shell ground.
